section: Which vehicle types get the best highway gas mileage?
text:
Which vehicle types get the best highway gas mileage?
Among the complete records, 4dr Hatchback has the highest average at 36.1 MPG (686 records). These are unadjusted averages, so vehicle age and other characteristics are not held constant.

title: Stories
section: Which cars balance price, power, and fuel economy?
text:
Which cars balance price, power, and fuel economy?
To make “balance” explicit, each complete record gets an equal-weight score: the average of its percentile ranks for affordability (lower price ranks higher), horsepower (higher ranks higher), and highway MPG (higher ranks higher). These are the top-ranked records in this dataset by that definition, not a universal best-car ranking.

title: About the Data
text: The site reads a CSV file named cars_msrp_kaggle.csv, hosted in a GitHub Gist by dvinubius. The raw CSV currently contains 11,914 rows and 16 columns. The project uses this hosted file; its original collection date and methodology are not documented here, so the prices should not be treated as current listings.

title: About the Data
text:
Variables used in the site







Dataset field
How it is used




Make
Vehicle manufacturer.


Model
Vehicle identification and comparison.


Year
Model year.


MSRP
Listed price, used to compare affordability.


Engine HP
Engine horsepower, used as the performance measure.


highway MPG
Highway fuel economy for the MPG charts and balance score.


Vehicle Size
Color grouping in the scatterplots.


Vehicle Style
Vehicle type used in the MPG group comparison.



The source also includes fields such as city MPG, engine fuel type, transmission, drive type, and popularity. The current charts focus on the fields listed above.

title: About the Data
text:
Analysis notes
The site uses the available fields to compare listed price, engine horsepower, highway fuel economy, vehicle size, and vehicle style. The balance score is a project-specific comparison that gives equal weight to price, horsepower, and highway fuel economy; it is not an official vehicle rating.
